name: Cato the Elder
biography: Roman statesman embodying the 'stern, stiff, stupid, and brutal' traditional Roman moral code; personally austere and honest but casually cruel to his slaves; opposed Carneades's lectures and Greek philosophical education generally, fearing it would corrupt Roman youth away from martial virtue.
